coverageSpotVerification.detail: All 58 suite-required mappings for M1-M6 and M8 were read against scripts/acceptance*.mjs; every mapped test exists, ran green in the grader's aged-seed run, and exercises its assertion's observable (independently re-checked by grader API/web checks). Weak-but-honest mappings: m2-a15 (asserts only the final cleared like state, never the intermediate count 1); m1-a04 (asserts any non-empty auth error); m2-a01..a03 and m5-a04/a05 use the API rather than the UI (UI paths covered by the frozen harness); m4-a09's test is seed-age dependent (defect d-04). M7 has no mappings (never attempted). No dishonest mapping found.

defects.summary: A user's own message sent from another device (or the API) shows an unread badge in that user's web chat list: unreadCount is latest.ordinal > readOrdinal without excluding the viewer's own messages (src/chat.tsx Chats/RecentChats), so multi-device read state reports the sender's own message as unread until the conversation is opened.
The server accepts a top-level post with an empty body and no media (social.create body is `text <=500` with no content requirement), producing a blank feed item.
The server accepts editing a text message to the empty string (edit takes `text <=2000` while send requires `text 1..2000`), leaving a blank, non-tombstoned bubble marked edited.

The documented acceptance entrypoint is seed-age dependent: the M4 suite probes the edit window by editing seeded message sm0001 and expects EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED. Run within 60 s of seeding (nothing in README forbids it), the edit is legitimately accepted, M4 fails, and sm0001 is overwritten with "Too late", which then fails the M5 in-chat search test. Reproduced twice from a clean checkout; passes when run after the window.

O1.anchorsCited: Between 60 ("M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and 90 ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts"), closer to 90.
O1.justification: 101 of 119 assertions pass under grader execution (85 of the 101 prior-schema IDs; 16 of 18 M8). Every web/API checklist item of M1-M6 and M8 passed (suite, frozen harness re-run by the grader, grader API/web checks). Not passed: all 9 M7 assertions (M7 not-run, stays in the denominator) and the 9 native-artifact assertions (m6-a01..a07, m8-a17/a18) for which no simulator artifact exists. iOS Hermes bundle exports exist per milestone, but the 90 anchor is not met because M7 is absent and the native offline platform proofs are missing. Evidence: trace.md#o-dimension-scores.

O2.anchorsCited: Between 60 ("a few medium defects off the happy path") and 90 ("only cosmetic nits").
O2.justification: No blocker or major defect found. Four minor defects: d-01 own-message unread badge on the other device (wrong data in a multi-device flow), d-02 empty posts accepted, d-03 edit-to-empty accepted, d-04 seed-age-dependent acceptance suite that corrupts seeded data. Exploratory authorization checks (non-member read/send/react/add, non-admin add/promote/disappearing, removed-member send, non-member asset fetch, over-length inputs) were all refused correctly. Typing-indicator expiry passes with only ~0.1-0.2 s margin under the 5 s bound (noted, not a defect).

O4.anchorsCited: Below the 30 anchor ("cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app"); nowhere near 60 ("reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush") or 90 ("reads, ordered queued writes, receipt transitions, and offline search all behave as specced on the native proof - on full runs including M8's durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence").
O4.justification: O4 is scored only from the harness's simulator artifacts. None exist: no iOS simulator recording or receipt for M6 or M8 (harness summaries list ios-simulator-m6/m8 as not-recorded; the lane has only Hermes bundle exports, although the installed CLI offers `snapback4 witness ios`). Nothing native was demonstrated, so the score sits under the 30 anchor. It is not 0 because the lane does not claim a native proof (README: "Hermes bundles, not simulator installation proofs"); the run record's note that ENVIRONMENT made simulator proofs unnecessary is inaccurate. Web-harness offline receipts (M6 queue flush to read, M8 dual-offline convergence) and the grader's web cold-offline control passed but are not O4 inputs. M6 web green satisfies the applicability gate.

notes: Uncalibrated grader: the claude family has not passed the calibration gate (calibration.md); this grade is labeled uncalibrated-grader. N=1 calibration run, not a claim-eligible wave. Probe results are empty on purpose: no holdout probe set was committed for this wave (probeSetSha256 = none-uncommitted), so execution-order phase 4 was skipped and no probes were invented. Exploratory authorization checks in the trace are defect-finding only and were not used as probes. O3 is null although its gate is met (M6 green, M1-M5 attempted): applicability.json scores O3 only from the wave's rotated holdout probes, and none exist. O5 is null although the replay was attempted: the band function needs the frozen performance probe set with its p95 predicates, calibrated ceilings and a frozen replay cap, and none exist for this wave. The 0 branch was checked and did not fire: the grader's independent read-only check of a cloned scale store matched invariant-manifest-combined.json exactly (all per-entity, 1002 per-chat, 1008 per-user following/conversation and 101 group-member counts, named O5 fixtures, spot entities), and the replay settled 167157/167157 actions in 878 s (6.1% of the 4 h stand-in cap; not exhausted). The lane's own timing probes are unscored diagnostics and were not banded. Phase 1 ran three times: attempts 1 and 2 (M4 ran 39 s and 43 s after seeding) failed deterministically on the lane suite's seed-age dependence (defect d-04), not on grader tooling; attempt 3 (fresh store, 70 s after seeding) passed all seven milestones and supplies suiteResult. rerunsUsed counts the one phase re-run. M8 results (18 IDs) are in m8-assertion-results.json because this frozen schema only admits m1-m7 IDs.
